test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Please switch ___ the lights.
solution:
The correct answer is '**off**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**switch off**" is commonly used to indicate turning off an electrical device, such as lights.
 
• The other options do not fit the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"Please switch **off**__ the lights."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "down"** is incorrect because it does not indicate the action of turning off lights.
 
• **Option 2: "up"** is incorrect because it typically refers to turning something on or increasing brightness, not turning off.
 
• **Option 3: "over"** is incorrect because it does not fit the context of switching off lights.
